page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.12xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by AWS Graviton ARM64 processors. This instance features 48 dedicated physical cores running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz, with a single thread per core allocation. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

The r9gd.12xlarge includes 2850 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage, offering high-speed, low-latency local data access. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, managed via the AWS Nitro hypervisor. There are no GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64 architecture combined with dedicated physical cores offers high resource density and power efficiency for memory-intensive workloads. The integration of local NVMe SSD storage reduces the need for external block storage attachments for temporary data. This server is designed for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads, such as large-scale databases, in-memory caches, real-time data analytics, and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
